verdict.rationale: The only bulk-adjacent evidence is SOSPortal's shopping cart, which suggests several filings or orders can be combined into one checkout. Nothing documents bulk filing, bulk search, batch status checks or programmatic batch submission, and each search is billed individually. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch filing or search operations, batch status retrieval across many entities, API or file-based bulk upload, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
